note: Plain-English descriptions written by Readyline to help a provider recognise their own supports in the questionnaire. They are NOT NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission text and do not change which class applies; the Commission's class names and audit types in standards.json (source 'registration-groups') are authoritative. Draft until the product owner reviews them (REQ-003, question 2).
author: readyline

items.name: Accommodation/tenancy assistance
items.description: Helping a participant find, apply for and keep suitable housing, including support with tenancy obligations.

items.name: Assistance to access and maintain employment or higher education
items.description: Supporting a participant to find, start or stay in work or higher education, including help in the workplace or place of study.

items.name: Assistive products for personal care and safety
items.description: Supplying equipment that helps with personal care and safety at home, such as shower chairs, hoists or alarms.

items.name: High Intensity Daily Personal Activities
items.description: Daily personal care that needs specific skills, such as complex bowel care, tube feeding, tracheostomy, ventilator, catheter or complex wound care.

items.name: Personal mobility equipment
items.description: Supplying wheelchairs, walking frames, scooters and other equipment that helps a participant move about.

items.name: Assistance in coordinating or managing life stages, transitions and supports
items.description: Helping a participant plan and manage life changes such as leaving school or moving home, and coordinating their supports (general support coordination).

items.name: Assistance with daily personal activities
items.description: Hands-on help with everyday personal activities such as showering, dressing, eating and getting around at home.

items.name: Assistance with travel/transport arrangements
items.description: Helping a participant get to appointments, work or community activities, including driving them or arranging transport.

items.name: Vehicle modifications
items.description: Modifying a vehicle so a participant can drive or travel in it, such as hand controls or hoists.

items.name: Specialist positive behaviour support
items.description: Assessing behaviour and writing behaviour support plans as a specialist practitioner, including plans that contain regulated restrictive practices.

items.name: Home modifications
items.description: Building changes at home such as ramps, rails and bathroom alterations so a participant can live more independently.

items.name: Assistive equipment for recreation
items.description: Supplying equipment for sport, leisure and recreation adapted to a participant's needs.

items.name: Vision equipment
items.description: Supplying magnifiers, screen readers and other equipment for participants who are blind or have low vision.

items.name: Community nursing care
items.description: Nursing care delivered in the community by a nurse, such as wound care, continence care or medication support.

items.name: Assistance with daily life tasks in a group or shared living arrangement
items.description: Help with daily tasks in a group home or shared living arrangement where participants live together with support.

items.name: Innovative community participation
items.description: New or different ways of supporting participants to take part in their community, outside the usual support types.

items.name: Development of daily living and life skills
items.description: Teaching skills for everyday living such as cooking, budgeting, using public transport or managing a household.

items.name: Early intervention supports for early childhood
items.description: Early intervention for young children with developmental delay or disability, delivered together with their family.

items.name: Specialised hearing services
items.description: Audiology and related specialised services for participants with hearing loss.

items.name: Household tasks
items.description: Help with household jobs a participant cannot do themselves, such as cleaning, laundry, gardening and meal preparation.

items.name: Interpreting and translation
items.description: Interpreting and translating, including Auslan, so a participant can communicate and access information.

items.name: Hearing equipment
items.description: Supplying hearing aids and related devices.

items.name: Assistive products for household tasks
items.description: Supplying equipment that helps with household tasks, such as adapted kitchen or cleaning aids.

items.name: Communication and information equipment
items.description: Supplying communication devices and information technology adapted for a participant, such as speech-generating devices.

items.name: Participation in community, social and civic activities
items.description: Supporting a participant to join in community, social, recreational or civic activities, including one-to-one community access.

items.name: Exercise physiology and personal training
items.description: Exercise physiology and personal training programs designed around a participant's disability-related needs.

items.name: Management of funding for supports in participant plans
items.description: Managing the funds in a participant's plan on their behalf: paying providers and keeping the records (plan management).

items.name: Therapeutic supports
items.description: Allied health therapies such as occupational therapy, physiotherapy, speech pathology, psychology and dietetics.

items.name: Specialised driver training
items.description: Driving lessons and assessments adapted to a participant's disability so they can learn to drive safely.

items.name: Assistance animals
items.description: Providing and training assistance animals, such as guide dogs, and supporting the participant to work with them.

items.name: Specialist disability accommodation
items.description: Owning or managing purpose-built housing for participants with very high support needs, as the housing provider (not the daily support).

items.name: Specialised support coordination
items.description: Support coordination for participants in high-risk or complex situations, delivered by specialised coordinators.

items.name: Specialised supported employment
items.description: Employment in a supported setting with ongoing on-the-job support, such as a supported employment enterprise.

items.name: Hearing services
items.description: General hearing services, such as hearing assessments and fitting of devices.

items.name: Customised prosthetics
items.description: Making and fitting custom prosthetics and orthotics for a participant.

items.name: Group and centre-based activities
items.description: Group programs and centre-based activities where participants take part together, such as day programs.

items.name: Providing an NDIS digital platform service
items.description: Running an online platform whose main purpose is connecting participants with the people who provide their supports, with payments processed through it.

items.name: Assistance with supported independent living
items.description: Managing and delivering a package of home and living support for a participant who needs support for most or all of the day (supported independent living).
